session_focus.summary: cic-ingestion build was silently broken (invalid ignoreDeprecations value, masked by tsx bypassing tsconfig checking) - found root cause, removed dead config, verified clean build, pushed. trm-vault had 227 uncommitted files with zero git safety net ahead of planned dedup/ingest work - staged and committed as one snapshot after confirming the apparent deletions were actually a .txt->.json format migration, not data loss. New standing rule adopted: commit trm-vault after every real ingest/dedup run, not batched. MEMORY.md compacted 160->103 lines per hook flag.
incidents: cic-ingestion npm run build broken via TS5103 (ignoreDeprecations:'6.0' invalid for pinned tsc 5.4.5) - no CI or test caught it because tsx bypasses tsconfig type-checking entirely. Fixed by deleting the dead flag (verified no real deprecation warnings exist under 5.4.5 without it).
trm-vault had a stale .git/index.lock from a killed process mid-commit, blocking the safety-net commit until cleared.

Streak still breaks at 2026-07-25 - confirms this is systemic: real work that day (and other days) lands in trm-vault which has no remote and wasn't committed in near-real-time, so repo-scoped git history undercounts actual output.
process_learnings: trm-vault commit discipline was the actual root cause behind the 07-25 dark-day gap and the 227-file exposure - not a missing day of work, a missing day of committing. New feedback memory (feedback_trm_vault_commit_per_run) should close this going forward.
